description: Five ungrouped issues that all touch authentication but describe separate pieces of work; a correct answer returns an empty proposals array.

autoship-batch-proposer.task:
Step 2b of /dev-team:autoship: the deterministic grouping pass left these issues ungrouped. Their titles and bodies follow (the same text is in `{fixture}/issues.md`).

### #301: Rate-limit failed login attempts

After 5 failed logins for one account within 10 minutes, reject further attempts for 15 minutes.

### #302: Support SAML single sign-on for enterprise tenants

Enterprise customers need to log in through their identity provider using SAML 2.0.

### #303: Password reset email uses the wrong sender name

Reset emails show "noreply" instead of the product name as the sender.

### #304: Show last login time on the account page

Display the date and time of the previous successful login under the profile picture.

### #305: Upgrade bcrypt library to the latest minor version

Routine dependency bump; no API changes expected.

Respond with only the JSON object defined by your output contract.

rubricPoints.requirement: Returns `{"proposals": []}` (no groupings), because the issues only share the authentication area and are separate pieces of work.
Does not group any issues on shared topic alone (for example login rate limiting with SSO, or password reset with last-login display).
